notes.title: Join our Discord Q&A Event - July 25, 2025
notes.content:
[p]👋 Hey, campers!

We're excited to announce that we will be hosting an upcoming [b]Discord Q&A[/b] as a startup event for our community. This will be one of the best chances to ask questions about the game, as well as general things that may interest you.   

This forthcoming voice-based livestream will be hosted by the Community Representative and it is expected to take approx. 1 hour. However, depending on availability, we might add some extra minutes in there for general questions.  

🔪  For more information about the event, please consider joining our Discord server: [url="https://discord.gg/zkQXh4MxeA"][b]HERE[/b][/url][b].[/b]  

Thank you for your constant support. We hope to see you there in good numbers!
    
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3633340/SummerCamp/"][/dynamiclink][/p]
